Subject: Re: Onsite schedule confirmation — Wed 4/30 (10:00–13:00 PT)

Hi Marissa — thank you for the confirm and for sending the resume back through. I’ve run into a scheduling conflict at my current role — they just moved a mandatory all-hands into the 11:00–12:30 window that I can’t push. I can still make the 10:00–11:00 block and remain available by phone for the code walkthrough after that, or I can do the first two interviews today (10:00–11:30) and finish the last panelic session at a follow-up time tomorrow. I’m really excited about Redwood and don’t want to hold the team up — whichever you prefer. Apologies for the short notice.

Sam
sam.tang@gmail.com
+1 415-555-0987

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Apr 2024 09:12:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Candidate day-of partial availability — decision needed

Markus / Mina — Sam just wrote saying his current employer added a mandatory all-hands that overlaps with our mid-slot. He can do 10:00–11:00 (first two panel items) and either take a brief phone/code check after, or finish the final interviewer tomorrow.

Options:
- Run 10:00–11:00 today (core system design + culture) and reschedule the deep technical 1:1 for tomorrow (30–45m)
- Run full scheduled block for the interviewers who can; convert the remaining items into a short take-home + 30m sync

I’d prefer the first option if it keeps momentum and reduces candidate churn, but want your call on whether the panel can make a decision without the final system deep dive. Mina: would you be comfortable prioritizing the system design piece in the first hour, or is that the slot you had planned for later?

—
Marissa

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Apr 2024 09:25:41 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate day-of partial availability — decision needed

Thanks for flagging, Marissa. I’m fine running 10:00–11:00 today focused on culture + core product questions and saving the deep systems 1:1 for tomorrow afternoon. We don’t need to make a hiring decision today; this is still a prescreen -> on-site flow for us. Mina — can you move your planned topics to the first hour and focus on high-level architecture and one deep question that would give us enough signal to decide whether to proceed to comp? If not, option two (take-home + 30m sync) is acceptable.

I’ll be on standby in case the candidate can be flexible.

—
Markus Klein
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Apr 2024 09:33:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate day-of partial availability — decision needed

I can shift. I’ll cover system architecture high-level + one deeper cache/kv question in the first 50 minutes; then hand off the deep benchmark/throughput discussion to the rescheduled session. Please let the candidate know we can do the first hour today and book a 45m follow-up for tomorrow (afternoon preferred).

Mina
Senior Staff Engineer

Thanks for the quick reply, Sam — totally understand. The panel can adapt: we’ll run 10:00–11:00 PT today covering the core culture and high-level architecture items; Mina will focus on the system design signal and we’ll reschedule the deep technical 1:1 for tomorrow (45m) in the afternoon. If you prefer a short take-home instead of a second live block, let me know and we’ll arrange it.

I’m booking the follow-up for tomorrow 14:00–14:45 PT tentatively and will send the calendar update — if that doesn’t work tell me a couple windows that do. Please join the 10:00 link a few minutes early and bring the same ID.

See you shortly.
